title: Decision Filters
hook: I was re-deciding which clients to take every single week. Now I have one rule and it takes seconds.
statement: Decide what matters ahead of time. A clear rule turns repeat decisions into quick ones.
explainer: Decision fatigue is real. Every repeat choice drains energy you need for the big stuff. A standing rule answers it once so you don't have to keep thinking.
sop: Pick one decision that comes up over and over.
Write a clear rule that answers it in advance.
Rate the Clarity of that rule from 1 to 10.
Count the Options you usually weigh when it comes up.
Apply the rule the next 5 times, no exceptions.
equation_example: Clarity 9, Options 3. 9 ÷ 3 = 3.0. Higher means a clear rule cuts through the choices fast. Lower means your rule is fuzzy or you're juggling too many live options.
question: Write one standing rule that would kill ten decisions a week.
closing_statement: A decision made once beats the same decision daily.
